items.title: 54270_Doc Cheatham oral history interview
items.q: Juan Tizol came over to the Cotton Club and took me to see Duke, says, I think Duke can use you.

ctx.x: Oh, yes. I wanted so bad to play with Duke's band. I wanted very much to play with Duke. I thought I had an opportunity, at one time, Juan Tizol came over to the Cotton Club and took me to see Duke, says, I think Duke can use you. So he took me over there to the theater, where Duke was playing. And I went -- he took me in the dressing room and set me down there. Duke and I had a talk, he was making up and going on the stage, I sat there for an hour boy he didn't say anything to me about working with his band. I…
He did -- I did get an offer from him just before he went to Tokyo, the last time, but I didn't accept it because I -- I was doing a little better than what he offered at that time.
